errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many wrong attempts. This account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts from this device. Please wait and try again.
errors.NETWORK: Can't reach the server. Check the connection.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

orders.title: Orders
orders.loadError: Couldn't load the orders. Check the connection and press Refresh.

detail.shippingNote: Customer pays the driver for delivery.
detail.selectHint: Select an order to see the details.

actions.paidWarning: This order was paid. After cancelling, send the money back and mark it as refunded.
actions.customerSees: The customer sees this reason and note on the order lookup page. Please also call or message them.

errors.ORDER_CHANGED: Someone else just updated this order. The list has been refreshed.
errors.CANNOT_REFUND: Only cancelled, paid orders can be marked as refunded.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.ACTIVE_ORDERS: This customer still has an order in progress. Erase after it is delivered or cancelled.
errors.ALREADY_ERASED: This order's customer details were already erased.

privacy.eraseExplain: Use this when the customer asks you to delete their data. Their name, phone and address are erased from all of their finished orders. This cannot be undone.
privacy.erased: Customer details were erased for privacy.

bulk.title: Cancel many orders
bulk.hint: Cancel every open order for one delivery day, or only those with one cake. Use it when an ingredient runs out or the shop must close.
bulk.none: No open orders for this choice.
bulk.paidCount: {count} of them are paid and need a refund.
bulk.refundHint: These orders were paid. Send each customer their money back, then press "Refunded".

settings.title: Shop settings
settings.loadError: Couldn't load the settings. Check the connection and refresh.
settings.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

bank.title: Bank account
bank.hint: Shown to customers after they order, with a QR code they can scan.
bank.accountNameHint: Write it exactly as the bank shows it, without accents (e.g. NGUYEN VAN A).

contact.title: Contact
contact.hint: Shown in the website footer. Leave a field empty to show “Coming soon”. Links must start with https://

rules.title: Hours and order rules
rules.smallLead: Hours of notice for small orders
rules.largeLead: Hours of notice for large orders
rules.maxDays: Customers can order up to (days ahead)
rules.maxQuantity: Most of one flavor per order (items, 1 box = 1 item)

zones.title: Delivery areas
zones.hint: Customers choose one of the active areas. Switch an area off instead of deleting it.

capacity.title: Portions per day (next 14 days)
capacity.hint: Change a single day, e.g. more for a holiday or 0 for a day off. Lowering a day only stops new orders.

business.title: Business details
business.hint: Shown at the bottom of every page and in the policy pages. Online shops in Vietnam must show who runs them.
business.retentionHint: After this many months from delivery, the customer's name, phone and address are erased automatically. Amounts and items stay for your accounts.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.hint: Staff get a Telegram message for every new order and every auto-cancelled order. Messages contain no customer name, phone or address.
telegram.sent: Test message sent. Check your Telegram group.
telegram.notConfigured: Telegram is not set up yet (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in the backend .env).
telegram.failed: Telegram refused the message. Check the bot token, the chat id, and that the bot is in the group.

pause.title: Pause orders
pause.hint: Turn on when something goes wrong (illness, power cut, broken oven). Customers can still see the menu but can't order.
pause.saveHint: Press "Save" above to apply. The site updates within about a minute.

sold.title: Show sold count
sold.hint: Shows “120 sold” under the cake name on the menu and product pages. It counts portions of paid orders, not cancelled ones.
sold.on: Sold count is shown to customers
sold.minimum: Only show from this many portions
sold.minimumHint: Cakes that have sold only a few portions don't show it yet, so they don't look unpopular. Press Save at the bottom; the shop updates within a few minutes.

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.hint: Takes effect as soon as you press Save changes at the bottom.
reviews.windowDays: Customers can review for (days after delivery)
reviews.reportAlert: Tell the shop after this many reports

products.title: Products
products.loadError: Couldn't load the products. Check the connection and refresh.

categories.title: Categories
categories.hint: Groups shown as filters on the menu page. The slug is the short name used in links (e.g. panna-cotta).

editor.saved: Saved. The shop pages update within a few minutes.
editor.slugTaken: This slug is already used by another product or category.
editor.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
editor.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Changing it breaks old links to this cake.
editor.allergensHint: e.g. Milk, eggs, wheat, nuts. Customers with allergies rely on this.
editor.flavorsHint: Extra price is added to the price of one portion. Leave empty if the cake has only one flavor.
editor.packagesHint: Portions = how many pieces in the box. Adjustment is added to the box price (negative = box discount).
editor.removeHint: Removed options are switched off, not deleted, so old orders stay correct.
editor.soldOutUntil: Sold out up to and including
editor.soldOutHint: Customers can't order this cake for delivery on those days; it opens again the day after. Empty = selling normally.
editor.dailyLimitHint: The most portions of this cake taken for one delivery day. Empty = no limit of its own.
editor.availabilityHint: Sold out or Coming soon: the cake stays on the menu with a label, but customers can't order it. Stays until you switch back to On sale.

stock.title: Availability
stock.saved: Saved. The shop updates within a few minutes.
stock.staffHint: Staff can change the status (On sale / Sold out / Coming soon) of each cake and flavor, Sold out until, and the daily limit of each cake and flavor. Ask an admin to change prices, photos or names.

images.productHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB each; you can pick several at once. Square photos look best. Location data is removed automatically.
images.bannerHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB. Wide photos (about 16:9) look best. Location data is removed automatically.
images.unsaved: Press "{button}" to put it on the shop.
images.tooLarge: This photo is larger than 8 MB.
images.badType: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
images.notConfigured: Photo storage is not set up yet (R2 settings in the backend .env).
images.tooMany: Too many uploads. Please wait a little and try again.
images.galleryHint: The first photo is the cover, shown on the menu and in the cart.
images.someSkipped: Some files were skipped: only JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB.
images.tooManyPhotos: A cake can have up to {max} photos; the extra ones were skipped.

home.title: Homepage
home.saved: Saved. The shop updates within about a minute.
home.loadError: Could not load the homepage settings. Please reload the page.
home.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

announcement.title: Top bar
announcement.hint: The thin black bar above every page. Leave a text empty to hide it.
announcement.center: Middle text (one message per line; several lines take turns)

hero.title: Big banner
hero.hint: The dark banner at the top of the homepage, usually for the newest cake. It is the first slide; add Extra banners below to take turns with it.
hero.heading: Title
hero.subtitle: Description
hero.intervalHint: 3 to 30 seconds. Only matters when there are extra banners.

slides.title: Extra banners (take turns)
slides.hint: Shown after the Big banner above, switching every few seconds. Add dates to show one only during a promotion; leave them empty to show it always.
slides.empty: No extra banners. Only the Big banner is shown.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.hint: The homepage shows the season that is running today. Later, customers who buy every cake of a season will get a reward.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.hint: Cards at the bottom of the homepage about cakes that are on the way.

noAccess.title: This page is for admins only
noAccess.body: Staff accounts can use the Orders tab and the Sold out / Daily limit controls in Products. Ask an admin for anything else.

password.title: Change password
password.forcedHint: You signed in with a temporary password from an admin. Choose your own password; after that, not even the admin knows it.
password.hint: A short sentence is easy to remember, e.g. best-flan-in-district-3. Don't reuse your email or bank password.
password.saved: Password changed. Other devices signed in to this account were signed out.

errors.TOO_SHORT: The new password needs at least 12 characters.
errors.MISMATCH: The two new passwords don't match.
errors.SAME_PASSWORD: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: Admins can use everything. Staff can only use the Orders tab (except erasing customer data) and Sold out / Daily limit in Products.
accounts.loadError: Couldn't load the accounts. Please reload the page.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.turnOffHint: A switched-off account can't sign in and is signed out right away. Order history keeps this person's name.
accounts.resetConfirm: Create a new temporary password for {name}? The old password stops working and they are signed out everywhere.

temp.title: Temporary password for {name}
temp.hint: Shown only once. Give it to this person directly (in person or a private message), not in a group chat. They must set a new password at their first sign-in.

errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email already has an account.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can't switch off, demote or reset your own account. Change your own password with Change password in the black bar.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: At least one active admin must remain.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.hint: Enter the email of your account. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email has an account, the message arrives within a few minutes. Check the Spam or Promotions folder too. The link works once, for 30 minutes.
forgot.noEmail: No email? Ask another admin to press Reset password in the Accounts tab.
forgot.resetDone: Password changed. Please sign in with your new password.

errors.LINK_INVALID: This link has expired or was already used. Press Forgot password to get a new one.
errors.NO_TOKEN: The link is incomplete. Open the exact link from the email, or get a new one.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
errors.NETWORK: Can't reach the server. Check the connection.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.

stats.title: Sales
stats.hint: Only orders marked “Payment received” and not cancelled, by delivery day. Revenue is for cakes only; customers pay shipping to the driver.
stats.loadError: Couldn't load the figures. Please reload the page.
stats.empty: No paid orders in this period.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: Choose how you hear about new orders, even when the admin page is closed. Notifications never include the customer's name, phone or address.

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.hint: Shows an app-style notification on the phone or computer you are using, even after closing the admin page. Each device is switched on separately.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications. Use Chrome on Android or a computer, or Safari on iPhone (see the steps).
push.needsHomeScreen: On iPhone, add the admin to the home screen first, then switch notifications on:
iosSteps: Tap Share (the square with an up arrow), choose “Add to Home Screen”, tap Add.
Open Chuvachi from the new home screen icon, sign in, go to Notifications and switch on. Needs iOS 16.4 or later.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Open the site settings in your browser (the lock icon next to the address), allow Notifications, then reload.
push.off: This device doesn't get notifications yet.
push.on: This device gets new order notifications.
push.turnedOn: Switched on. Press Send a test notification to check.
push.turnedOff: Notifications switched off on this device.
push.testSent: Sent. It should appear within a few seconds.
push.testNone: Couldn't reach any device. Try switching off and on again.
push.notConfigured: The server has no notification keys (VAPID) yet. See the handbook.
push.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
push.perDevice: Signing out doesn't stop notifications; switch them off on the device itself.

email.title: New order emails
email.hint: Emails {email} for every new order and every auto-cancelled order.
email.gmailTip: Tip: turn on Gmail app notifications on your phone so these emails ring like messages. If one lands in Spam, mark it “Not spam” once.

sound.title: Sound while the admin is open
sound.hint: The bell in the black bar plays a ding and counts waiting orders in the tab while the admin page is open. After each reload, press the bell once (a browser rule).

inbox.buttonWithCount: {count} orders waiting for the payment check
inbox.title: Orders to handle
inbox.waiting: You have {count} orders waiting for the payment check
inbox.noneWaiting: No orders waiting for the payment check
inbox.waitingHint: Check the bank app; if the money is there, open the order and press Payment received.

adminSearch.placeholder: Find a setting or feature... (e.g. bank, sold out)

orders.keywords: orders today tomorrow confirm payment delivered status

ordersBulk.label: Cancel many orders
ordersBulk.keywords: bulk cancel out of ingredients closed
ordersBulk.hint: Button at the top of Orders

refund.label: Refund a customer
refund.hint: Open the cancelled order, press Refunded

stock.label: Sold out, coming soon, daily limit
stock.keywords: sold out coming soon limit portions status flavor
stock.hint: Under each cake or in Edit

pushAlerts.label: New order notifications on my phone
pushAlerts.keywords: notifications phone push iphone android bell

photos.label: Add or change cake photos
photos.hint: Press Edit on the cake, Photos box

contact.label: Phone, Messenger, social links
contact.keywords: contact phone messenger facebook instagram tiktok

business.label: Business details, how long customer data is kept

rules.label: Opening hours, lead time, auto-cancel, delivery slots, closed days
rules.keywords: opening hours lead time auto cancel slots closed days default portions

capacity.label: Portions per day, close a day

eraseCustomer.label: Erase customer data on request
eraseCustomer.hint: Open one of the customer's finished orders

reviews.label: Customer reviews and comments
reviews.keywords: reviews comments stars hide spam reply report

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.hint: Reviews are written only by buyers (from delivered orders). Comments are written by customers signed in with Google. Everything shows at once; hide spam, ads or rude content. Replies show as Chuvachi.
reviews.loadError: Couldn't load the reviews. Please reload the page.
reviews.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
reviews.hiddenDone: Hidden. Customers no longer see it.
reviews.removePhotoConfirm: Remove this photo? It is deleted for good; the text stays.
reviews.deleteForeverConfirm: Delete this review with its photos and comments for good? Use this when the customer asks. It can't be undone.
